about: The joint Collect commemorates Saints Alexander, Eventius, and Theodulus, martyrs, together with Saint Juvenal, bishop and confessor. The petitioners celebrate their feasts and ask to be delivered from threatening evils through the intercession of all four.

s01.translation: Grant, we pray, almighty God, that we who celebrate the feasts of Your saints Alexander, Eventius, Theodulus, and Juvenal may be delivered, through their intercessions, from all evils that threaten us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

alignments.gloss: who lives and reigns with You

w006.explanation: “We who” means the petitioners celebrating the feasts. These same people ask to be delivered.

w013.explanation: The joint heading calls Juvenal a bishop and confessor. The other three named saints are martyrs.

w014.explanation: The plural names the saints’ festal observances. The preceding genitive phrase names whose feasts are celebrated and includes all four saints, not just the three martyrs.

w039.explanation: God describes Christ, the Son, not the Father being addressed. The Son lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
